Copy 694
C. I. D.
694
Translation of a letter received by Cho Lap Fong
on 20th March 1916.
To Messrs Ching Tsai, Lan Fong, and Say Siang.

Gentlemen:
Although we have not the pleasure of seeing you, we have long appreciated your generosity..
Having successfully attained our object in strengthening the people's rights in the year of 1911, the members of our party gave up their positions in order that they might devote their attention to improving the material existence of our people. It was then our hope that the country would soon become strong and people would enjoy the blessings of a Republic.
However Yuan under the name of Republicanism has adopted the policy of despotism. He removed his opponents and misruled the country resulting in corruption in the internal administration and difficulties in diplomatic negotiations.
Hence we started the revolution in 1913 but the citizens then not knowing the treachery of Yuan, assisted the "tiger" which caused a failure in the revolution. What then was our sufferings?
We were obliged to start the revolution in view of the misrule of Yuan and in the hope of saving our people. Yuan seeing the speedy suppression of the late insurrection and the strong support of his adherents who have been scattered over the country making opposition impossible, then dreamed of making himself Emperor. He has sold the country. In addition to the twenty one demands which he has recognised he offers the concession of the articles mentioned in Group 5 as an exchange for the recognition of the Monarchy. Internally he utilized the military men in fabricating the opinion of the people in favour of the change.
Now Generals Dong and Tsar have declared independence in the south west and are endeavouring to preserve the Republic by means of iron and blood.
The enemy is being besieged in Szechuan and the Yunnan soldiers are entering Hunan and attacking them in the rear. Following the Kwangsi independence came the defeats of the enemy's army.
Our influence is growing stronger and sympathy is felt whenever our army passes. The rich help us with money and the strong assist us with their strength.
We have long known you as being generous and patriotic and very anxious to see the restoration of the Republic in the East Asia. The contributions from various places mostly go to the needs in the south west and therefore financial difficulties are being felt in this province. We hope that you being enthusiastically interested in national affairs, will not neglect your native place, the Kiangsu province. We request that you will within three days jointly raise $100,000.00 and give to us for distribution so as to enable us to speedily carry out our aim to a successful issue.
As soon as the new Republican Government is established we will mortgage the first Debenture Bonds as a pledge the amount you lend us.
Your gain is the privilege of patriots in lending us the money while we receive the support of a loan most needed in such a time when we act in a revolution. Thus we enjoy the benefits alike. We presume you will not refuse the loan.
If you grant our request please immediately publish an advertisement in Sinwanpao and or Taung Wah Sin Pao

副本 694
刑事侦缉处
694
祝兰芳于 1916 年 3 月 20 日收到信件的译文。
致郑才、兰芳及赛祥先生。

诸位先生：
虽未谋面，但久仰各位慷慨之风。
吾党于 1911 年成功实现强化民权之目标后，成员皆辞去职位，以便专心改善我国人民之物质生活。当时吾等希望国家能迅速富强，人民能享受共和之福。
然而袁氏假借共和之名，行专制之实。他铲除异己，治国无方，导致内政腐败，外交谈判陷入困境。
因此，吾等于 1913 年发动革命，但当时民众不知袁氏之奸诈，反而助纣为虐，致使革命失败。吾等所受之苦楚又如何呢？
鉴于袁氏暴政，并为拯救同胞，吾等不得不再次发动革命。袁氏见前次起义被迅速镇压，且其党羽遍布全国，势力强大，令人无法反抗，便妄图称帝。他已出卖国家。除了承认二十一条要求外，他还提出以第五组条款中所列各项权益作为交换，以换取对其君主制的承认。对内，他利用军人伪造民意，制造支持变更国体的舆论。
如今，董将军与蔡将军已在西南宣布独立，正努力以铁血手段维护共和。
敌军在四川被围困，云南军队正进入湖南，从后方攻击敌军。继广西独立之后，敌军屡遭败绩。
吾等影响力日益增强，军队所到之处，皆获同情。富者出资相助，强者出力相援。
吾等久知诸位慷慨爱国，并热切期盼东亚恢复共和。各地捐款多用于西南之需，故本省面临财政困难。望诸位热心国事，勿忘故乡江苏省。恳请诸位在三日内共同筹集十万元（$100,000.00），交予吾等分配，以便吾等能迅速达成目标，取得圆满成功。
新共和政府一旦成立，吾等将以首批债券作为抵押，担保诸位借予吾等之款项。
诸位出借资金，享有爱国者之特权；而吾等在革命行动之际，获得急需之贷款支持。如此双方均蒙其利。想必诸位不会拒绝此笔借款。
如蒙应允，请立即在《新闻报》或《通华新报》刊登广告
